title: 玻璃回收色選與純化
titleEn: Color sorting and purification of recycled glass
summary: 以「玻璃回收色選與純化」為研究主題，規劃拆解物料與能量流程、處理單元、環境績效及驗證。目前為選題路線圖，逐步課程與專案細節尚待編審；所附通用來源屬類別背景。
summaryEn: Study topic: Color sorting and purification of recycled glass. Planned coverage includes material and energy flows, treatment units, environmental performance and verification. Roadmap entry: step-by-step lessons and project details await editorial review; general references provide category context.
